# Moon Phases

Source: https://www.tradingview.com/script/NZ5F60bq-Moon-Phases-TradingTruth/

## Description

🌙 Moon Phases

Visualize the lunar cycle directly on your chart and explore how market behavior aligns with the different phases of the Moon.

Moon Phases marks every New Moon, Full Moon, and optionally the First Quarter and Last Quarter, allowing traders to study recurring market behavior, timing, volatility, and potential turning points through a clean, distraction-free interface.

Whether you're researching market cycles or simply curious about the relationship between lunar phases and price action, this indicator provides an elegant way to incorporate astronomical timing into your chart analysis.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌑 New Moon Detection

Automatically marks every New Moon.
Optional background highlighting for quick visual identification.

🌕 Full Moon Detection

Displays every Full Moon with clear chart labels.
Subtle background shading helps distinguish Full Moon periods.

🌓 Quarter Moon Support

Optionally display:
First Quarter
Last Quarter
Ideal for traders researching intermediate lunar cycle behavior.

📅 One Signal Per Lunar Event

Labels are plotted only on the first trading bar of each lunar phase.
Prevents duplicate signals across multiple candles.

📊 Live Moon Information
The information panel displays:

Current Moon Phase
Moon Phase Angle
Current Date

🎨 Minimal Chart Clutter
Designed to stay out of the way while remaining easy to read:

Clean emoji labels
Optional phase labels
Light background highlights
Works across all markets and timeframes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📈 USE CASES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Many traders enjoy studying lunar cycles alongside traditional technical analysis to investigate potential relationships with:

• Market turning points

• Volatility expansions

• Trend continuation

• Swing highs and lows

• Time cycle analysis

• Seasonal market behavior

This indicator is designed as a research and visualization tool, allowing you to perform your own historical analysis without making assumptions about market direction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 BEST USED WITH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Combine Moon Phases with:

Market Structure
Support & Resistance
Volume Analysis
Wyckoff Methodology
Gann Time Cycles
Elliott Wave Analysis
Session Analysis
Trend Following Systems

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ DISCLAIMER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This indicator does not generate buy or sell signals.

Moon phases should be treated as one of many timing factors within a broader trading methodology. Always combine them with sound technical analysis, proper risk management, and market context before making trading decisions.

I also think a stronger title for TradingView would be:

🌙 Moon Phases
🌙 Moon Phases for Traders
🌙 Lunar Market Cycles
🌙 Moon Cycle Tracker
🌙 Moon Phases & Market Timing
🌙 Lunar Cycle Indicator
🌙 Trading Truth Moon Phases (if you're releasing it under your brand)

For discoverability on TradingView, "Moon Phases" or "Moon Phases for Traders" are the strongest choices because they're simple, searchable, and immediately communicate the indicator's purpose.

310,310')

// Reference date
START_DATE = timestamp("2020-01-01 00:00:00")

// Get the date of the current bar (normalized to start of day)
current_day = timestamp(year(time), month(time), dayofmonth(time), 0, 0, 0)

// Calculate days since start
days_since_start = math.floor((current_day - START_DATE) / 86400000)
current_index = math.min(math.max(days_since_start, 0), array.size(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE) - 1)

// Get current and previous moon phase
current_moon_phase = current_index >= 0 and current_index < array.size(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE) ? 
                     array.get(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE, current_index) : na

prev_moon_phase = current_index > 0 and current_index < array.size(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE) ? 
                  array.get(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE, current_index - 1) : na

// Determine moon phase type
is_new_moon = not na(current_moon_phase) and (current_moon_phase < 10 or current_moon_phase > 350)
is_full_moon = not na(current_moon_phase) and current_moon_phase > 170 and current_moon_phase < 190
is_first_quarter = not na(current_moon_phase) and current_moon_phase > 80 and current_moon_phase < 100
is_last_quarter = not na(current_moon_phase) and current_moon_phase > 260 and current_moon_phase < 280

// Check if this is the FIRST day of the phase (transition)
was_new_moon = not na(prev_moon_phase) and (prev_moon_phase < 10 or prev_moon_phase > 350)
was_full_moon = not na(prev_moon_phase) and prev_moon_phase > 170 and prev_moon_phase < 190
was_first_quarter = not na(prev_moon_phase) and prev_moon_phase > 80 and prev_moon_phase < 100
was_last_quarter = not na(prev_moon_phase) and prev_moon_phase > 260 and prev_moon_phase < 280

// Only plot on the first day of each phase
plot_new_moon = is_new_moon and not was_new_moon
plot_full_moon = is_full_moon and not was_full_moon
plot_first_quarter = is_first_quarter and not was_first_quarter
plot_last_quarter = is_last_quarter and not was_last_quarter

// **KEY FIX: Only show on the first bar of each day**
is_first_bar_of_day = ta.change(current_day) != 0

// Plot moon phases only on first bar of the day
// plotshape(plot_new_moon and is_first_bar_of_day, "New Moon", shape.circle, location.belowbar, color.black, size=size.small)

enable_full_and_new_moon_phases = input.bool(true, "Enable Full and New Moon Phases")


enable_quarter_phases = input.bool(false, "Enable Quarter Phase")
// Add labels only on first bar of the day



if plot_new_moon and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_full_and_new_moon_phases
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🌑", style=label.style_none, color=color.black, textcolor=color.white, size=size.large)


if plot_full_moon and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_full_and_new_moon_phases
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🌕", style=label.style_none, color=color.yellow, textcolor=color.black, size=size.large)

if plot_first_quarter and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_quarter_phases
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🌓", style=label.style_none, color=color.blue, textcolor=color.white, size=size.large)

if plot_last_quarter and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_quarter_phases
    label.new(bar_index, high, "🌗", style=label.style_none, color=color.orange, textcolor=color.white, size=size.large)

    label.new(bar_index, low, "New", style=label.style_text_outline, color=color.black, textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)

if plot_full_moon and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_full_and_new_moon_phases

if plot_last_quarter and is_first_bar_of_day and enable_quarter_phases
    label.new(bar_index, low, "LQ", style=label.style_text_outline, color=color.orange, textcolor=color.white, size=size.normal)

// Plot moon phase angle (optional)
plot(current_moon_phase, "Moon Phase Angle", color=color.new(color.purple, 50), linewidth=2)

// Display table
var table moonTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 3, border_width=1)

if barstate.islast
    table.cell(moonTable, 0, 0, "Moon Phase:", bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(moonTable, 1, 0, str.tostring(math.round(current_moon_phase, 1)) + "°", bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)
    
    phase_name = is_new_moon ? "🌑 New Moon" : 
                 is_full_moon ? "🌕 Full Moon" : 
                 is_first_quarter ? "🌓 First Quarter" : 
                 is_last_quarter ? "🌗 Last Quarter" : 
                 current_moon_phase < 90 ? "🌒 Waxing Crescent" :
                 current_moon_phase < 180 ? "🌔 Waxing Gibbous" :
                 current_moon_phase < 270 ? "🌖 Waning Gibbous" : "🌘 Waning Crescent"
    
    table.cell(moonTable, 0, 1, "Phase:", bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(moonTable, 1, 1, phase_name, bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)
    
    table.cell(moonTable, 0, 2, "Date:", bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(moonTable, 1, 2, str.format("{0,date,yyyy-MM-dd}", time), bgcolor=color.new(color.gray, 70), text_color=color.white)

// Background highlighting
bgcolor(is_full_moon ? color.new(color.blue, 97) : na, title="Full Moon BG")
bgcolor(is_new_moon ? color.new(color.black, 97) : na, title="New Moon BG")




isNewMonth = month(time) != month(time[1])

monthLabelPosition = input.string(
     "Top",
     "Month Label Position",
     options=["Top", "Bottom"])

monthLocation = monthLabelPosition == "Top" ? location.top : location.bottom
monthStyle    = monthLabelPosition == "Top" ? shape.labeldown : shape.labelup

plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 1,  title="January",   text="Jan", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.red,     textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 2,  title="February",  text="Feb", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.orange,  textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 3,  title="March",     text="Mar", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.yellow,  textcolor=color.black, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 4,  title="April",     text="Apr", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.green,   textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 5,  title="May",       text="May", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.teal,    textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 6,  title="June",      text="Jun", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.blue,    textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 7,  title="July",      text="Jul", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.navy,    textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 8,  title="August",    text="Aug", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.purple,  textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 9,  title="September", text="Sep", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.fuchsia, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 10, title="October",   text="Oct", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.maroon,  textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 11, title="November",  text="Nov", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.gray,    textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(isNewMonth and month(time) == 12, title="December",  text="Dec", style=monthStyle, location=monthLocation, color=color.black,   textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
if isNewMonth
    line.new(
         x1=bar_index,
         y1=-1e10,
         x2=bar_index,
         y2= 1e10,
         xloc=xloc.bar_index,
         extend=extend.none,
         color=color.new(color.gray, 60),
         style=line.style_dotted,
         width=1)

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Moon Forecast
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

showMoonForecast = input.bool(true, "Show Moon Forecast")
forecastDays     = input.int(60, "Forecast Days", minval=1, maxval=365)

DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

// Persistent arrays
var label[] moonForecastLabels = array.new_label()
var line[]  moonForecastLines  = array.new_line()

if barstate.islast and showMoonForecast

    //──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Delete previous forecast
    //──────────────────────────────────────────────

    while array.size(moonForecastLabels) > 0
        label.delete(array.pop(moonForecastLabels))

    while array.size(moonForecastLines) > 0
        line.delete(array.pop(moonForecastLines))

    //──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Build new forecast
    //──────────────────────────────────────────────

    for i = 1 to forecastDays

        futureIndex = current_index + i

        if futureIndex < array.size(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE)

            angle     = array.get(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE, futureIndex)
            prevAngle = array.get(MOON_PHASE_ANGLE, futureIndex - 1)

            futureTime = current_day + DAY_MS * i

            futureNewMoon =
                 (angle < 10 or angle > 350) and
                 not (prevAngle < 10 or prevAngle > 350)

            futureFullMoon =
                 (angle > 170 and angle < 190) and
                 not (prevAngle > 170 and prevAngle < 190)

            if futureNewMoon

                ln = line.new(
                     x1=futureTime,
                     y1=-1e10,
                     x2=futureTime,
                     y2=1e10,
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     color=color.new(color.white, 60),
                     style=line.style_dashed,
                     width=1)

                array.push(moonForecastLines, ln)

                lbl1 = label.new(
                     x=futureTime,
                     y=high,
                     text="🌑",
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     style=label.style_none,
                     color=color.black,
                     textcolor=color.white,
                     size=size.large)

                array.push(moonForecastLabels, lbl1)

                lbl2 = label.new(
                     x=futureTime,
                     y=low,
                     text="New",
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     style=label.style_text_outline,
                     color=color.black,
                     textcolor=color.white,
                     size=size.normal)

                array.push(moonForecastLabels, lbl2)

            if futureFullMoon

                ln = line.new(
                     x1=futureTime,
                     y1=-1e10,
                     x2=futureTime,
                     y2=1e10,
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     color=color.new(color.yellow, 45),
                     style=line.style_dashed,
                     width=1)

                array.push(moonForecastLines, ln)

                lbl1 = label.new(
                     x=futureTime,
                     y=high,
                     text="🌕",
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     style=label.style_none,
                     color=color.yellow,
                     textcolor=color.black,
                     size=size.large)

                array.push(moonForecastLabels, lbl1)

                lbl2 = label.new(
                     x=futureTime,
                     y=low,
                     text="Full",
                     xloc=xloc.bar_time,
                     style=label.style_text_outline,
                     color=color.yellow,
                     textcolor=color.black,
                     size=size.normal)

                array.push(moonForecastLabels, lbl2)
